mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY growth > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as companies face higher costs.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE < 5% does not correlate with subsequent cost pressures.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strengthening demand in the housing sector, which boosts economic activity and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of instances despite the positive signal, or HOUST increases do not correlate with subsequent economic activity.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic growth slows.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO decreases do not correlate with subsequent economic slowdowns.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) YoY growth is below 2%, the real interest rate is positive, signaling a restrictive monetary environment that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL does not correlate with subsequent market performance.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.5% in the same month, it signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the combination of PAYEMS and UNRATE does not correlate with subsequent market performance.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real final sales of domestic product (RSAFS) by more than 1% QoQ signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or RSAFS increases do not correlate with subsequent economic activity.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) increases by more than 2% YoY and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 6%, it signals a robust economy with strong supply and labor conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the combination of INDPRO and UNRATE does not correlate with subsequent market performance.
